name: Kfir C.10 Block 60
axis_orientation: nose is at +1, tail is at -1
operating_principle: The IAI Kfir C.10 is a delta-wing multirole fighter powered by a General Electric J79-J1E turbojet engine, featuring advanced avionics and a robust airframe designed for high-speed and high-maneuverability performance.

components.description: The main structural body of the aircraft, housing the cockpit, engine, and fuel tanks.
The delta-wing configuration provides high lift and maneuverability, with multiple hardpoints for carrying payloads.
The tail section, comprising the vertical stabilizer and rudder, provides stability and control during flight.
The compartment housing the General Electric J79-J1E turbojet engine, providing the necessary power for flight.
The retractable landing gear system, enabling the aircraft to take off and land safely.
The compartment housing the advanced avionics systems, including the Elta EL/M-2032 multimode radar.
The compartment housing the pilot and flight control systems, providing a safe and efficient working environment.
The system providing air to the engine, ensuring efficient combustion and power generation.
